purpose: Read-only final incoming branch/PR frontier for Zotero rich ODT work, before root's final main reconciliation.

capture_scope.branch_pagination: GitHub search_branches page_size 100: 27 branches; cursor Mjc yielded terminal empty page. Exact heads obtained from REST branches page 1, per_page 100, then rechecked.
capture_scope.excluded_reason: This session's incremental checkpoint; not incoming work.
capture_scope.snapshot_limit: Refs and PR status are point-in-time observations. They are not locked against subsequent concurrent pushes.

methods: Read GitHub REST main ref and branch metadata through GitHub connector.
Read all branch names and latest 100/all open PR summaries through GitHub connector.
Compare every incoming fork head with exact frozen final main.
Directly compare new PR heads 306 through 309 with final main.
For unchanged older recent PR heads use exact initial audit ancestry plus direct initial-to-final main ancestry.
Recheck main, branch heads and open PR status; compare the changed VBA head against current main, initial main and its previous observed head.
No remote mutations, Actions, workflows, check/status queues or CI waits.

main_advancement.assessment: 19 changed files are Mail conversation/core/UI, reader, account workspace and credential storage plus documentation. This main delta has no quds_office_engine or Zotero paths.

new_pull_request_details.title: Mail: add account-scoped conversation ordering in loaded mailbox views [skip ci]
new_pull_request_details.head: work/mail-parity-next-20261121
new_pull_request_details.body:
## Feature
- Introduce an account-scoped pure-Dart conversation grouper for explicit RFC `Message-ID`, `In-Reply-To` and `References` headers, with malformed-input and size limits.
- Add optional conversation ordering and a thread-size affordance to the **compact** shared mailbox list without removing individual message rows or changing their actions.
- Wire IMAP, EWS/cloud, cached and synchronized headers; localize English/German/Arabic.
- Add core and Flutter widget regression suites and a precise mail parity continuation roadmap.

## Concurrent integration
- Started from main `2f90a0c8f214` after reconciling all earlier forks/branches and open PRs.
- Merged current main with two parents on the work branch, retaining the newly merged compact reader and credential vault updates. Incoming changes to the compact header chrome and plain-text/body-only reader are retained together with the conversation toggle.
- No forced ref updates or lost remote incremental commits.

## Checks
- Manual source and merge review completed; remote main ancestry checked (branch behind=0).
- **Dart and Flutter tests not executed**: neither SDK is available in this execution environment. Tests are committed but not claimed passing. No GitHub Actions wait (free-tier queue is starved); feature commits use `[skip ci]`.
- Follow-up requires on-device/toolchain validation and provider smoke tests, plus persisted cross-folder threading for fuller client parity.

See `docs/roadmaps/mail/conversations.md`.

new_pull_request_details.title: Extend Word VBA language controls and preserve independent font slots [skip ci]
new_pull_request_details.head: codex/word-vba-language-controls-20261121
new_pull_request_details.body:
## Why

Word macros cannot assign supported proofing languages or choose a complex-script font through the existing transactional source adapter. Native font-property ownership also groups independent slots, risking unrelated font metadata during edits.

## Changes

- Add bounded Range.LanguageID and LanguageIDOther setters for 30 explicitly mapped normal-slot language IDs, plus Font.NameBi.
- Preserve separate font/language attributes, explicit inheritance overrides, theme selection and foreign native metadata; guard ambiguous source before mutation.
- Reconcile all captured recent work, including the new Mail conversation core. The intake covers all 305 existing PRs, 26 fork heads and all upstream heads/PRs.
- Preserve incremental checkpoints on this branch. Include source tests and a runnable BAS example.

## Checkpoint status

Compiler checks pass 110 cases; the initial native suite passes 49 cases. The incoming Mail conversation/search slice independently passes 110 tests at its captured head. Final native integration, CLI/MCP, VM/JavaScript agreement and source-bound evidence are in progress; this draft does not claim final acceptance.

The user requested eventual merge to remote main without waiting for the starved free-tier Actions queue. No Actions, workflow, status or check queues are queried or awaited. Final local results and exact limitations will be recorded before merge.

new_pull_request_details.title: Probe the data-protection keychain write path before selecting it
new_pull_request_details.head: fix/system-keychain-write-probe-20261121
new_pull_request_details.body:
An unentitled build returns item-not-found for reads, so the old detection kept the data-protection backend and only failed when saving an account.

Probe a write/read/delete cycle instead. Fall back to the login keychain only for -34018; locked or denied keychains remain explicit failures.
